label: Campground Business Registration
kw: Campground business registration agent in Korea
answer: Campground business registration (야영장업 등록) is the procedure for anyone who wants to let tourists use a campsite or auto campground to register it as a tourist-facility business under the Tourism Promotion Act (관광진흥법). After meeting the registration standards, such as a safe location, evacuation routes, management staff and at least 15 square meters per tent or 50 square meters per vehicle, you file the tourism business registration application with the competent city mayor, county head or district head. The processing period on the application form is 7 days, and it takes longer if permits under other laws must be confirmed or documents supplemented. YouSun Administrative Agency prepares and files the registration application and business plan.

Corporations opening campgrounds with glamping or caravan facilities

glance.label: Who needs it
glance.value: General campground and auto campground businesses that let tourists use a site equipped with facilities and equipment suitable for camping and that provide camping conveniences (youth campgrounds are excluded)

glance.label: Requirements
glance.value: A safe location with no risk of flooding, washout or landslides; posted site layout and emergency instructions; emergency alert equipment; fire extinguishers; shelters and evacuation routes; management staff on site during opening hours; total building floor area under 10% of the entire site; at least 15 square meters per tent (general) or 50 square meters per vehicle (auto); no disqualification

glance.label: Process
glance.value: Confirm the location and permits under other laws → install facilities that meet the registration standards → file the registration application and documents → review → registration certificate issued → take out liability insurance before starting business

glance.label: Documents
glance.value: Tourism business registration application, business plan, document stating the applicant's name and resident registration number (for foreign nationals, documents proving no disqualification applies), facility floor plan and site layout, facility list, proof of permits under other laws, pre-use electrical inspection certificate, and a water quality test report if groundwater or similar is used as drinking water

glance.label: Timeline
glance.value: 7 days on the registration application form (varies if permits under other laws must be confirmed or documents supplemented); change registration must be filed within 30 days of the change

situations.q: Do I need campground business registration in Korea to run a glamping site with pre-pitched tents?
situations.conclusion: If the business lets tourists use a site equipped with facilities and equipment suitable for camping and provides camping conveniences, it must be registered as a campground business even in glamping form. It must meet the general campground standards (such as at least 15 square meters per tent) and the common standards.

branches.when: The site mainly offers tent-type facilities
branches.then: Register after meeting the individual standards for a general campground: at least 15 square meters per tent, sewage facilities, toilets and a vehicle lane for emergency transport.

branches.when: Buildings such as a management building or shower block are also built
branches.then: Check that the total building floor area is under 10% of the entire campground area.

branches.when: It is a youth campground under the Youth Activity Promotion Act (청소년활동진흥법)
branches.then: It is excluded from campground businesses under the Tourism Promotion Act, so follow the procedure under that Act.

situations.docs: Tourism business registration application, business plan, facility floor plan and site layout, facility list, pre-use electrical inspection certificate, proof of permits under other laws
situations.period: 7 days on the registration application form; in practice, time for facility installation and permits under other laws is added

situations.q: Is a campground in Korea that takes caravans and camper vans registered as an auto campground business?
situations.conclusion: If you provide space to park a vehicle and set up camping equipment next to it, plus facilities suitable for cooking and the like, for tourists traveling by car, it is an auto campground business. It requires at least 50 square meters of camping space per vehicle, plus water supply and sewage, electricity, toilets and cooking facilities.

branches.when: Guests park and camp beside their vehicles
branches.then: Register after meeting the individual standards for an auto campground and the common standards.

branches.when: There is also an area for tents only, without vehicles
branches.then: Check whether that area also meets the general campground standard (at least 15 square meters per tent).

situations.docs: Tourism business registration application, business plan, facility floor plan and site layout, facility list, pre-use electrical inspection certificate, water quality test report (if groundwater or similar is used as drinking water)
situations.period: 7 days on the registration application form; in practice, it depends on whether supplementation is needed

situations.q: Which permits should I check before campground business registration if I want to build a campsite on farmland or forest land in Korea?
situations.conclusion: Before campground business registration, first confirm and obtain the permits under other laws, such as building, farmland and mountain land laws, that allow a campground on that land. Proof of those permits is submitted with the registration application.

branches.when: Facilities are installed on farmland or mountain land
branches.then: Obtain the permits under those laws first, then lay out the facilities within that scope to meet the registration standards.

branches.when: The land is in a conservation management area or conservation green area
branches.then: Additional requirements such as area limits apply, so first check whether facilities can be installed.

branches.when: The location is at risk of flooding, landslides or falling rocks
branches.then: It does not meet the common standard of a safe location, so reconsider the site.

situations.docs: Land use records, proof of permits under other laws, facility floor plan and site layout
situations.period: In practice, the permit period under other laws drives the overall schedule (campground business registration itself is 7 days on the form)

situations.q: How much building space, such as a management building or shower block, can a campground in Korea have?
situations.conclusion: The total floor area of buildings at a campground must be under 10% of the entire campground area. Additional limits apply in conservation management areas and conservation green areas.

branches.when: The campground is in an ordinary area
branches.then: Design so that the combined floor area of all buildings, including the management building, showers and toilets, is under 10% of the entire area.

branches.when: The land is in a conservation management area or conservation green area
branches.then: Meet the additional requirements such as area limits as well.

situations.docs: Facility floor plan and site layout, facility list
situations.period: In practice, meeting the area standards at the design stage reduces supplementation requests

situations.q: By when must a registered campground in Korea take out liability insurance?
situations.conclusion: A registered campground operator must, before starting business, take out liability insurance or mutual aid coverage that compensates users for damage caused by disasters or safety accidents at the campground facilities.

branches.when: You have the registration certificate and are preparing to open
branches.then: Before opening, take out liability insurance that meets the standards, such as coverage of up to KRW 100 million per victim for death and up to KRW 100 million per accident for property damage.

branches.when: The campground is already operating
branches.then: Check that the insurance remains in force along with the safety and hygiene standards that apply after registration, such as fire prevention standards.

situations.docs: Tourism business registration certificate, proof of liability insurance or mutual aid coverage

situations.q: Our campground uses groundwater for drinking water. What extra documents are needed for campground business registration in Korea?
situations.conclusion: In addition to the basic documents, if groundwater or other non-tap water is used as drinking water, you must submit a water quality test report issued by a drinking water testing agency. The pre-use electrical inspection certificate and proof of permits under other laws are also additional documents required for campground businesses.

branches.when: Groundwater or similar is used as drinking water
branches.then: Obtain a water quality test report and attach it.

branches.when: There are LPG-using facilities
branches.then: The completion inspection certificate is checked by the authority through administrative information sharing.

branches.when: The applicant or a corporate officer is a foreign national
branches.then: Submit documents proving that no disqualification applies.

situations.docs: Tourism business registration application, business plan, document stating the applicant's name and resident registration number, facility floor plan and site layout, facility list, proof of permits under other laws, pre-use electrical inspection certificate, water quality test report
situations.period: 7 days on the registration application form; missing documents add time for supplementation

situations.q: If we add campsites or facilities to our campground in Korea, do we need to file a change registration?
situations.conclusion: For campground businesses, changes in site area, installation or removal of facilities, and changes of trade name or representative require change registration, and the tourism business change registration application is filed within 30 days of the change.

branches.when: The site was expanded or new sites or amenities were installed
branches.then: File the change registration with proof of the change, and check that the added facilities meet the registration standards (area and building ratio).

branches.when: Gas-using facilities were installed or removed
branches.then: Also check whether an LPG-using facility completion inspection is required.

branches.when: Only the trade name or representative changed
branches.then: Apply with the change registration application and proof of the change.

situations.docs: Tourism business change registration application, documents proving the change, updated floor plan and site layout
situations.period: File within 30 days of the change

situations.q: If I buy a campground that is already operating in Korea, do I need a new campground business registration?
situations.conclusion: When a tourism business is transferred, the buyer succeeds to the operator's rights and obligations and must report the succession to the competent registration authority within 1 month of the succession date.

branches.when: You acquired the business by transfer
branches.then: Check whether any disqualification applies to the buyer and file the succession report within 1 month.

branches.when: You acquired all major facilities through an auction or similar
branches.then: You succeed to the operator's status, so report within the same deadline.

branches.when: The previous operator has received an administrative sanction
branches.then: The effect of the sanction may carry over, so check before the acquisition.

situations.docs: Succession report, documents proving the transfer, documents confirming the buyer's disqualification status
situations.period: Report within 1 month of the succession date

situations.q: We have been running a campsite in Korea without registration. How can we register it now?
situations.conclusion: Running a campground business without registration is punishable by imprisonment of up to 2 years or a fine of up to KRW 20 million, so check against the registration standards, put any missing facilities in place and apply for registration right away.

branches.when: The site mostly meets the location, area and safety facility standards
branches.then: Add whatever is missing, such as evacuation routes, fire extinguishers or posted notices, and file the registration application.

branches.when: Facilities were built without permits under other laws
branches.then: Permit issues under building, farmland or mountain land laws must be resolved first before registration.

situations.docs: Tourism business registration application, business plan, facility floor plan and site layout, facility list, proof of permits under other laws, pre-use electrical inspection certificate
situations.period: 7 days on the registration application form; in practice, time for facility fixes and permits is added

situations.q: How much does campground business registration cost in Korea, and what should I prepare first?
situations.conclusion: Costs vary widely depending on how much permit work for the location and facility upgrades are needed, so the first step is to check permits under other laws and whether the registration standards are met. The processing period for the registration application itself is 7 days on the form.

branches.when: Permits and facilities are already in place
branches.then: The work centers on drafting and filing the registration application, business plan, plans and facility list.

branches.when: Facilities need to be newly installed
branches.then: Design them to meet the area, building ratio and safety facility standards before construction.

situations.docs: Tourism business registration application, business plan, facility floor plan and site layout, facility list, pre-use electrical inspection certificate, proof of permits under other laws
situations.period: 7 days on the form; in practice, the time for permits and facility preparation sets the overall schedule

situations.q: If I hire an administrative agent for campground business registration in Korea, what do they handle?
situations.conclusion: We pre-check the registration standards, draft the tourism business registration application, business plan and facility list, organize attachments and file them with the competent city, county or district office, handle supplementation, and file change registrations and succession reports. We do not design or build facilities, carry out fire or electrical safety inspections, or do land surveys.

branches.when: Registering for the first time
branches.then: We prepare and file the documents from checking the location and permits under other laws through to issuance of the registration certificate.

branches.when: The campground is already operating
branches.then: We handle change registrations and succession reports, and provide guidance on safety and hygiene standards.

situations.docs: Land and building records, facility plans, applicant documents, records of permits under other laws
situations.period: 7 days on the form; in practice, it depends on whether supplementation is needed

glossary.def: A tourist-facility business that lets tourists use a site equipped with facilities and equipment suitable for camping and provides camping conveniences; youth campgrounds are excluded.
A business that provides space for setting up camping equipment together with facilities suitable for camping for use by tourists.
A business that provides space to park a vehicle and set up camping equipment next to it, plus facilities suitable for cooking and the like, for tourists traveling by car.

The common and individual standards required for campground business registration, including a safe location, emergency alerts, fire extinguishers and evacuation routes, on-site management staff, the building ratio and the area per tent or vehicle.
Registration filed within 30 days of a change in site area, installation or removal of facilities, or a change of trade name or representative of a campground business.
A document confirming that the pre-use inspection under the Electrical Safety Management Act (전기안전관리법) has been passed; it is attached to the campground business registration application.
Insurance or mutual aid coverage that compensates users for damage caused by disasters or safety accidents at the campground facilities; it must be in place before starting business.
Operating standards, such as fire prevention standards, set by Ordinance of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism (문화체육관광부령) that a registered campground operator must follow.
